description: Per-node number formatting via meta-flagged 'Format' children with subtree inheritance (CORE_MODEL_SPEC §6 item 10, §7b; META_NODES). The format MODEL + inheritance walk is TreeCalc's; numeric display rendering is delegated to OxFml. Conditional formatting and broader style rendering remain outside this first active slice. `node` is the content node; expect.resolved_format is its effective format and inherited_from names the source.

cases.name: a node with no own Format inherits an ancestor default
cases.note: Book.Sales has no Format child; the inheritance walk picks up the book-level Book.Format (0.00).

cases.name: the Format subtree is invisible to formulas
cases.note: Format and its children are is_meta=true; a formula cannot reference Book.Margin.Format — the host reads it only when rendering.
